geo-met-01-c1.text: Engineering and Technology History Wiki (IEEE History Center) (2023). Electrolytic Reduction of Aluminum. Engineering and Technology History Wiki.
geo-met-01-c1.quote: In 1886, Charles M. Hall and Paul-Louis-Toussaint Héroult, working separately, but at the same time, both discovered that alumina and electricity can make aluminum economically.
geo-met-01-c1.claim: yet it was effectively unobtainable until the Hall-Héroult electrolytic process (1886) made it cheap.

geo-met-01-c3.text: U.S. Geological Survey (Samantha M. Ewing) (2026). Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026: Cobalt. U.S. Geological Survey.
geo-met-01-c3.quote: Congo (Kinshasa) was the world’s leading source of mined cobalt and accounted for an estimated 73% of world total, followed by Indonesia, which accounted for 14%.
geo-met-01-c3.claim: About 70 % comes from the Democratic Republic of the Congo
